history.summary: FLAG - NOT A HINDU TEMPLE: 'Baba Namdev Temple' in Kanpur is actually a Sikh gurudwara - Gurudwara Baba Namdev Ji at Sabzi Mandi, Kidwai Nagar (Block O), Kanpur - keep-or-drop decision needed. It is dedicated to Bhagat Baba Namdev, the 13th-14th century Varkari saint whose 61 hymns are included in the Sri Guru Granth Sahib; the gurudwara hosts Gurpurab samagams (e.g. a Guru Ramdas Prakash Purab samagam). J.P. Nadda visited it. town_description: Kanpur is Uttar Pradesh's major industrial city on the south bank of the Ganga, about 80 km west of Lucknow. Once called the 'Manchester of the East', it is today a large commercial and educational centre with several prominent temples.
